snippet.title: Miracle Heroes: Temporal Bounty Hunter
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3095600/_/

Miracle Heroes is a multiplayer light rogue-like game where players must select suitable combinations from a rich arsenal of weapons and items to enhance their gear and survive in a world fraught with danger.

Game Features:

40 heroes with unique appearances and completely different gameplay.
Hundreds of weapons, each with its own characteristics. Upgrade your weapons and combine two top-tier weapons to create new legendary artifacts.
Over 200 items with diverse combinations and various special effects.
A customizable equipment system for personalized adjustments.
A variety of maps and difficulty levels offering different challenges.
